Interface PyValue

All Known Implementing Classes:
PyValue.Array, PyValue.Frame, PyValue.None, PyValue.Other, PyValue.PyDict, PyValue.PyList, PyValue.Str
public sealed interface PyValue permits PyValue.Array, PyValue.Str, PyValue.PyList, PyValue.PyDict, PyValue.Frame, PyValue.None, PyValue.Other
A value exchanged with Python. Numbers are numpy arrays in Python (Python lists or the array module if numpy isn't installed):
  • PyValue.Array: a numeric or boolean array with a shape (a scalar has the shape {}): float64, float32, int64, int32, int16, int8, uint8, uint16, uint32, uint64, bool
  • PyValue.Str: strings (a str or a list of str)
  • PyValue.PyList, PyValue.PyDict: list (tuple) and dict
  • PyValue.Frame: a pandas DataFrame (a dict of columns without pandas)
  • PyValue.None, PyValue.Other (any other object: its type and repr)
The data of an array is kept in row-major (C) order as in numpy.
